reason: A Web GUI skin plugin that changes the interface appearance with a historical painting background, branding, and session-selection styling while leaving conversations, model behavior, and network access unchanged.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供以1945年终战史料为主题的界面皮肤，包括油画背景、品牌标题和选中会话样式。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skin that adds a 1945 historical theme with a painting background, branded title styling, and selected-session accents.

capabilities: Modifies the Web GUI DOM and CSS
Embeds and displays a historical painting as a background image
Changes the document title and selected-session visual markers
Restores its DOM and CSS changes when unloaded
